Suggested DRY refactor (option (b) module-level explanation + one-liner per field) adds indirection at the IDE-hover layer for marginal benefit — the bead's 'reduces diff churn when policy text needs updating' argument is real but the rustdoc content has been stable across the JMAP-lbdy.* propagation already in flight. Per workspace AGENTS.md 'Bikeshedding': only flag things with engineering basis that would survive a code review comment thread; this would not. description: methods.rs has 6 identical 4-line doc-comment blocks for `extra` fields (GetResponse, ChangesResponse, SetResponse, QueryResponse, QueryChangesResponse, AddedItem). wire.rs has 2 more (JmapRequest, JmapResponse). SetError has one slightly longer variant. The blocks all say the same thing: \"Catch-all for vendor / site / private extension fields not covered by the typed fields above. Preserves unknown fields across deserialize/serialize round-trip per workspace extras-preservation policy (see workspace AGENTS.md).\" Suggested rewrite: define a private const `EXTRAS_DOC` and use `#[doc = EXTRAS_DOC]`, OR add a single module-level explanation at the top of methods.rs/wire.rs and shorten the per-field docs to a one-liner pointing to it. Reduces diff churn when the policy doc-text needs updating. Same pattern WILL be propagated to 30+ struct sites across the workspace (JMAP-lbdy.* sweep) — fixing it here first makes the propagation cleaner.
title: Per-struct doc-comment for extras field is copy-pasted 8 times within one file
